# FrameBridge

> Unofficial local ChatGPT browser image workflow for Windows and Codex, using standard Playwright and a visible user-configured Edge session. Current-user configuration/login/task consent is required. Not an official API, hosted service, quota bypass or security certification.

This is a navigation aid for documentation readers, not an indexing/ranking guarantee. Historical tests do not authorize new users. Automated output collection has service-terms risk. Live reference uploads and broader UI/platform support remain limited.
